  • 5. Sagāthakapuññābhisandavagga 5. Overflowing Merit, With Verses

Aṅgasutta Factors

“Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, sotāpattiyaṅgāni. “Mendicants, there are these four factors for stream-entry. Katamāni cattāri? What four? Sappurisasaṁsevo, saddhammassavanaṁ, yonisomanasikāro, dhammānudhammappaṭipatti—Associating with true persons, listening to the true teaching, rational application of mind, and practicing in line with the teaching. imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgānī”ti. These are the four factors for stream-entry.”

Dasamaṁ.

Sagāthakapuññābhisandavaggo pañcamo.

Tassuddānaṁ

Abhisandā tayo vuttā, Duve mahaddhanena ca; Suddhaṁ nandiyaṁ bhaddiyaṁ, Mahānāmaṅgena te dasāti.
